narration: The EIT lane reconstructs conductivity change inside a unit disk, from voltages measured on its boundary.
Sixteen electrodes, adjacent drive and adjacent measure: two hundred and eight measurements. Difference imaging against a uniform reference.
The truth, test Ta: one inclusion, radius 0.18, conductivity 1.5 on a background of 1.0.
The reconstruction finds it: localization error 0.023, size error minus 0.01, contrast recovery 0.87.
Truth against reconstruction. The second seed reproduces every verdict: all five tests pass, both seeds.
Resolution is worst at the centre, 0.042, best at the edge, 0.259. Mean 0.137; point-spread radius 0.209.
Two inclusions stay resolved down to a separation of 0.35. At 0.2 the measurement could not be made, and it is not filled in.
Noise only: the reconstruction stays below a ten-thousandth of the signal peak. Coverage within two sigma: 99.6 percent.
As noise rises to 2 percent, location error degrades gracefully to 0.072, inside the 0.35 bar.
The spectral check confirms the Cheeger bound, and refutes K star equals N loc: two against seventy-three. Ker D stays unpinned.
Limits, stated plainly: synthetic phantoms only. No rig, no real plant data, two dimensions, no contact impedance.
EIT lane: deterministic, numpy only, no model in the loop. Every number traces to the record.
